run_query.display_str_template: Run a WQL query in Workday
run_query.name: run_query

parameters.description: A WQL SELECT statement. The fields and data sources you can use are listed in Workday's WQL documentation.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: How many to return, 1 to 100. Workday's default is 20.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: How many to skip. Use 'next_offset' from an earlier run of this step to get the next page.
parameters.name: offset

count.description: How many records are on this page

has_more.description: True when there are more records after this page

next_offset.description: Pass as 'Start at' to get the next page; 0 when this is the last one

total.description: How many records Workday has in all

description: Work with Workday HCM: find workers and their teams, managers and hire dates, check time off balances and request time off, read organizations and job profiles, follow job postings, add prospects, and run WQL queries.

workday_new_job_posting_trigger.description: Runs when a job is posted in Workday Recruiting

workday_new_team_member_trigger.description: Runs when a worker joins a supervisory organization in Workday, as a new hire or a transfer

parameters.description: The supervisory organization (team) to watch. Pick one, or give its Workday ID from 'List supervisory organizations'.
parameters.name: supervisory_organization
